# Preface {.unnumbered}

This is a working draft of a doctoral thesis on compact successive-approximation ADCs for high-frame-rate radiation imaging, developed in the FRIDA project (Fast Radiation Imaging Digitizer Array).

The thesis is written once and published in two editions.
This web edition and the PDF (the download link in the sidebar) are built from the same source.
In the web edition, figures are interactive: hover over a point to identify it, drag to zoom, double-click to reset, and click a legend entry to hide or show a group.
Points from the ADC survey open their paper when clicked.
The PDF draws the same figures, with the same colours, markers, and scales, as static vector graphics.

Only the background chapter is drafted so far.
